title: Front Cover
content: A field-lab setup to investigate the infestation rates of the freshwater pearl mussel (Margaritifera margaritifera) on salmonids. This cover image relates to Research Article “In-field cage infestation patterns of host fish for the freshwater pearl mussel (Margaritifera margaritifera) in a fragmented river before restoration”, [https://doi.org/10.1002/aqc.70346] by Rock et al. Photo credit: Sebastian L. Rock.
